title: Graph Representation Learning via Adaptive Expectile Aggregation
abstract: arXiv:2610.37450v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Graph neural networks (GNNs) rely critically on neighborhood aggregation, yet conventional mean aggregation may fail to capture class-relevant distributional information, particularly in heterophilic graphs. We propose ExpectileGCN, an adaptive graph aggregation framework that introduces a learnable expectile level to capture neighborhood information beyond the mean. The proposed operator continuously adjusts aggregation between minimum- and maximum-type behaviors, with mean aggregation as a special case. A differentiable approximation based on sigmoid smoothing and fixed-point iterations enables end-to-end optimization. Theoretically, we establish stability properties and transductive generalization guarantees for ExpectileGCN. We further investigate its classification risk under heterophilic neighborhood models. translated_title: 基于自适应期望分位数聚合的图表示学习
translated_abstract: 图神经网络（GNN）在很大程度上依赖于邻域聚合，然而传统的均值聚合可能无法捕获与类别相关的分布信息，尤其是在异配图中。我们提出了ExpectileGCN，这是一种自适应的图聚合框架，它引入了可学习的期望分位数水平，以捕获均值之外的邻域信息。所提出的算子能够在最小值型与最大值型行为之间连续地调整聚合方式，而均值聚合只是其一种特例。基于sigmoid平滑和不定点迭代的可微近似使端到端优化成为可能。在理论上，我们为ExpectileGCN建立了稳定性性质和直推式泛化保证。我们进一步研究了其在异配邻域模型下的分类风险。对于信息丰富的邻域，我们证明期望分位数聚合可以利用类别相关的尺度差异来实现（摘要在此处截断）。
tldr: 提出ExpectileGCN框架，通过可学习的期望分位数水平对邻域信息进行自适应聚合，突破了传统均值聚合的局限，尤其能利用类别相关的尺度差异提升异配图上的分类性能，并具备稳定性与直推式泛化的理论保证。
en_tdlr: Proposes ExpectileGCN, an adaptive graph aggregation framework with a learnable expectile level that generalizes mean aggregation and exploits class-dependent scale differences to improve classification on heterophilic graphs, backed by theoretical stability and transductive generalization guarantees.
